# BPO Hive

> Managed B2B outbound and appointment setting for the USA, Canada and GCC. Campaigns start at USD 4,000 per month. Last updated 2026-10-04.

ACES means Analyze, Contrive, Execute, Scale. A touchpoint is an outreach action, not a unique prospect or meeting. Company-reported cumulative results are 21,200+ appointments and $25M+ client revenue; they are not forecasts or guarantees.
